_help: Add one object per business. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), name, cat (cafe|food|shop|museum|other), lat, lon, radius (meters to collect, default 60), card (short card title), story (1-2 lines about the place, Arabic), offer (what the user gets), code (coupon code shown to staff), until (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), terms (optional), demo (true = shows a 'demo' tag). Edit this file and push, or use admin.html to generate an entry.
